card.title: 80th PASUBIO
card.text: Damage dealt by this unit adds equal defense to your HQ.
card.flavorText: The Italian 80th regiment of the 9th Infantry Division Pasubio was a military unit that served during WWII. It was formed in 1939 and was part of the Pasubio division, which was named after the Pasubio massif, a mountain range in the Italian Alps. The 80th regiment saw action in several theaters of the war, including North Africa, the Balkans, and the Eastern Front. It was known for its bravery and determination, particularly during the Battle of Gazala in 1942, where it played a key role in the defense of Tobruk against the British forces. In 1943, the 80th regiment was sent to the Eastern Front, where it took part in the Battle of Kursk and the subsequent retreat of German and Italian forces. Despite suffering heavy losses, the regiment continued to fight until the end of the war. After the war, the 80th regiment was disbanded and its personnel were demobilized.
